raw_text:
ARJUN KULKARNI

+91 98765 12345 | arjun.kulkarni.ai@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/arjunkulkarni-ai | github.com/arjunkulkarni | Bengaluru, Karnataka
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
AI Developer with strong experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision and Generative AI. Built production-ready AI systems using Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain and LLMs. Experienced in developing RAG pipelines, AI copilots and intelligent automation platforms.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology — Computer Science & Engineering (2021–2025)
PES University, Bengaluru | CGPA: 9.4/10
Relevant Coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Structures, Linear Algebra, Artificial Intelligence, Database Systems
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, C++, Bash
AI/ML Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Keras, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph
Data & Tools: Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, Matplotlib, FAISS, ChromaDB, Jupyter
DevOps & Platforms: Git, Docker, Linux, AWS, REST APIs, Streamlit
EXPERIENCE
AI Engineer Intern — NeuralForge AI Labs (Jan 2025 – Present)
• Developed enterprise RAG chatbot over 250,000+ documents with 93% answer relevance.
• Fine-tuned Llama models for domain-specific knowledge retrieval.
• Built automated evaluation pipelines reducing testing effort by 45%.

Machine Learning Intern — VisionMind Analytics (May 2024 – Aug 2024)
• Developed predictive analytics models achieving 91% accuracy.
• Automated ETL and preprocessing workflows for large datasets.
PROJECTS
Enterprise AI Copilot | GPT-4, LangChain, FAISS
• Built AI assistant supporting 20,000+ simulated users.
• Reduced information retrieval time by 70%.

Medical Imaging AI | PyTorch, OpenCV
• Designed CNN model achieving 96.1% validation accuracy.

Multi-Agent Research Assistant | LangGraph, OpenAI API
• Created autonomous agents for research and document summarization.
CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
TensorFlow Developer Certification
Generative AI with Large Language Models — DeepLearning.AI
ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Top 2% in Kaggle NLP Competition.
Winner, National AI Innovation Challenge 2025.
Published 2 research papers in Applied Artificial Intelligence.
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
President, AI & Data Science Club.
Conducted workshops for 400+ students on LLMs and Prompt Engineering.
Technical Blogger with 15,000+ article reads.
